sources.entry: SuperClaude by SuperClaude-Org - A versatile configuration framework that enhances Claude Code with specialized commands, cognitive personas, and development methodologies, such as "Introspection" and "Orchestration".

summary.one_liner: SuperClaude is a meta-programming configuration framework that adds slash commands, specialized agents, behavioral modes, and MCP server integrations to Claude Code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a configuration framework that injects behavioral instructions into Claude Code to structure development work. It provides 30 `/sc:*` slash commands spanning brainstorming, design, implementation, testing, documentation, git operations, project management, and research. It defines 20 specialized agents (for example PM, deep research, security, and frontend roles) and 7 behavioral modes such as Brainstorming, Orchestration, Token-Efficiency, and Introspection. It offers a CLI (`superclaude install`, `superclaude mcp`, `superclaude doctor`) to install commands and optional MCP servers such as Tavily, Context7, Serena, and Playwright. A Deep Research feature describes multi-hop web searches with quality scoring and depth levels.
use_cases: Structure Claude Code sessions with slash commands for the full dev lifecycle
Run multi-hop deep web research from inside Claude Code
Install and manage MCP servers for Claude Code
Brainstorm, design, and estimate features before coding
Generate tests, docs, and code reviews via slash commands
Coordinate multiple specialized agents on a development task
how_to_run: Restart Claude Code and run /sc to list commands
stack: MCP servers (Tavily, Context7, Serena, Sequential-Thinking, Playwright, Magic, Morphllm-Fast-Apply, Chrome DevTools)
notable: 30 slash commands organized by lifecycle phase, with a /sc command listing all of them
20 specialized agents and 7 behavioral modes that inject instructions into Claude Code
Optional MCP server installer via the superclaude CLI, with interactive or named-server modes
Deep Research mode with planning strategies, up to 5 search hops, and depth levels from Quick to Exhaustive
Reads project docs like PLANNING.md and TASK.md at session start, per the README
caveats: The TypeScript plugin system (v5.0) is not yet available; the README says no ETA is set, and install instructions cover v4.x only
Some Deep Research options (depth, strategy, domains) are described as applying via TypeScript or specific integrations, so their availability is unclear
Performance claims (2-3x faster, 30-50% fewer tokens) depend on optional MCP servers, which the README says are installed via airis-mcp-gateway
